name: External Model Interfaces
description: Abstract interfaces and implementations for communicating with remote APIs and local model servers. Provides a consistent contract for sending prompts and receiving structured responses from any model source. All external I/O is behind abstract base classes for testability via dependency injection. This is a pure contract layer: the ModelClient ABC defines the consumer-facing interface, unified Pydantic v2 types normalize responses from heterogeneous backends, a three-category error hierarchy enables routing decisions, and thin adapter implementations bridge dependency contracts (remote_api_client, local_model_server) to the unified interface. No retry, budget, or routing logic lives here — just the contract and translation.

types.name: SourceType
types.description: Discriminator for the origin of a model response. Used by the Router and audit trail to distinguish local from remote completions.

types.name: Role
types.description: Role of a message in a conversation prompt. Aligned with remote_api_client's MessageRole for zero-cost mapping.

types.name: UnavailableReason
types.description: Categorized reason why a model source cannot fulfill a request. Used by SourceUnavailableError to communicate structured fallback context to the Router.

types.name: SourceInfo

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Whether this source is a local inference server or a remote API provider.

fields.name: provider_name
fields.description: Human-readable provider or backend name. For remote: 'anthropic', 'openai', 'google'. For local: 'ollama', 'vllm', 'llamacpp'.

fields.name: model_id
fields.description: Model identifier as recognized by the backend. E.g., 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514', 'gpt-4o', 'llama3:8b-instruct-q4_K_M'.

fields.name: backend_type
fields.description: Optional backend discriminator for local sources. One of 'ollama', 'vllm', 'llamacpp', or empty string for remote sources.

types.description: Frozen Pydantic v2 model identifying the origin of a completion. Carried on every CompletionResponse and every error for audit correlation. Provides enough context to reconstruct which exact backend produced or failed to produce a result.

types.name: Message

fields.name: role
fields.description: The role of this message in the conversation.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The text content of the message.

types.description: A single message in a conversation prompt. Aligned with remote_api_client's PromptMessage for zero-cost adapter translation.

types.name: GenerationConfig

fields.name: max_tokens
fields.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the response.

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: Sampling temperature. 0.0 = deterministic, higher = more random. Adapters clamp to backend-specific max if needed.

fields.name: top_p
fields.description: Nucleus sampling parameter. 1.0 = no filtering.

fields.name: stop_sequences
fields.description: Optional list of strings that, when generated, cause the model to stop. Empty list means no stop sequences.

types.description: Canonical generation parameters that control model output behavior. Adapters are responsible for clamping or converting values to backend-specific ranges (e.g., some providers cap temperature at 1.0). Frozen Pydantic v2 model.

types.name: UnifiedTokenUsage

fields.name: prompt_tokens
fields.description: Number of tokens in the prompt/input. 0 if not reported by the backend.

fields.name: completion_tokens
fields.description: Number of tokens in the generated completion. 0 if not reported by the backend.

fields.name: total_tokens
fields.description: Total tokens consumed (prompt + completion). Always populated — computed from components or from backend's total if breakdown is unavailable.

fields.name: is_estimated
fields.description: True if any token count is estimated rather than reported by the backend. Local backends that don't report prompt tokens set this to true.

types.description: Normalized token usage across all backends. Some backends (especially local) may not report exact prompt/completion breakdowns, so those fields are optional. The is_estimated flag signals when values are approximated rather than reported by the backend. Frozen Pydantic v2 model.

types.name: CompletionRequest

fields.name: messages
fields.description: Ordered list of Message objects forming the conversation prompt. Must be non-empty and contain at least one message with role USER.

validators.error_message: messages must contain at least one message

fields.name: generation_config
fields.description: Optional generation parameters. Defaults are deterministic (temperature=0.0) for reproducibility.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Caller-supplied request identifier for audit trail correlation. If empty, the adapter generates a UUID4 internally. Flows through to the underlying backend for end-to-end tracing.

types.description: Unified request for model completion, consumed by ModelClient.complete(). Pydantic v2 model carrying the conversation, generation parameters, and a request_id for end-to-end audit trail correlation. Consumer-driven: contains exactly what Apprentice core needs to send, nothing backend-specific.

types.name: CompletionResponse

fields.name: content
fields.description: The text content of the model's completion.

fields.name: source_info
fields.description: Provenance information identifying which backend and model produced this response.

fields.name: token_usage
fields.description: Normalized token usage for this completion.

fields.name: cost_usd
fields.description: Computed cost in USD for this completion. For remote sources, directly from TaskResponse.cost_usd. For local sources, always 0.0 (local inference has no per-request API cost).

fields.name: latency_ms
fields.description: Wall-clock latency in milliseconds for the completion (successful attempt only, excludes retry wait time for remote).

fields.name: response_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this response. Derived from the backend's request_id. Used for audit trail correlation.

types.description: Unified response from any model source. Frozen Pydantic v2 model. Normalizes remote TaskResponse and local InferenceSuccess into a single shape that Apprentice core consumes. Carries provenance (source_info), usage, latency, and cost for budget accounting and audit.

types.name: HealthReport

fields.name: available

fields.name: detail

fields.name: latency_ms
fields.description: Time spent performing the health check in milliseconds. 0.0 if no actual check was performed.

types.description: Unified health check result for any model source. Provides enough information for the Router to make routing decisions without knowing backend specifics. Frozen Pydantic v2 model.

functions.name: complete
functions.description: Send a completion request through the ModelClient and return a unified CompletionResponse. This is the primary abstract method on the ModelClient ABC, implemented by both RemoteModelAdapter and LocalModelAdapter. RemoteModelAdapter translates CompletionRequest to PromptMessage list + GenerationParams, calls remote_api_client.send_request, and maps TaskResponse to CompletionResponse. LocalModelAdapter translates CompletionRequest to InferenceRequest, calls local_model_server.infer, and pattern-matches on InferenceResult: InferenceSuccess maps to CompletionResponse, LocalModelUnavailable maps to SourceUnavailableError. All backend-specific errors are caught and mapped to the unified error hierarchy. A request_id is generated (UUID4) if not provided in the request.

functions.name: health
functions.description: Perform a health check against the underlying model source and return a unified HealthReport. This is an abstract method on the ModelClient ABC. RemoteModelAdapter performs a lightweight probe (e.g., a minimal API call or connectivity check) and returns available=true if the remote API is reachable and authenticated. LocalModelAdapter delegates to local_model_server.health() and maps HealthStatus to HealthReport: is_ready maps to available, loaded_model populates source_info.model_id. Never raises for operational failures — returns HealthReport with available=false and diagnostic detail.

functions.name: close
functions.description: Async cleanup method on ModelClient ABC. Closes the underlying backend client and releases resources. If the underlying client was injected (dependency injection), this is a no-op — the caller retains ownership. Safe to call multiple times (idempotent). After close(), subsequent calls to complete() on an adapter that owns its client will raise RuntimeError.

postconditions: If adapter owns the underlying client, it is closed after this call
If adapter does not own the underlying client (injected), no action is taken

invariants: All public functions and methods are fully type-annotated and return Pydantic models, primitive types, or None
ModelClient is an ABC with abstract methods complete(), health(), and close() — fail-fast enforcement via abc.abstractmethod
ModelClient provides non-abstract __aenter__ and __aexit__ that delegate to close() — all adapters are async context managers
No retry, budget, or routing logic exists in this component — it is a pure contract and translation layer
All operational errors from backend dependencies are mapped to the unified three-category error hierarchy: RetriableError, TerminalError, SourceUnavailableError
Programming errors (wrong types, invalid arguments) raise standard Python exceptions (TypeError, ValueError) — these are not part of the unified hierarchy
CompletionResponse.cost_usd is always 0.0 for local source completions
CompletionResponse.token_usage.is_estimated is always false for remote source completions (remote APIs report exact counts)
Every CompletionResponse and every error carries a non-empty request_id / response_id for audit trail correlation
SourceInfo is immutable after construction — adapters update their internal source_info only on successful model promotion
Adapters are thin translation layers with no business logic — they translate types and map errors, nothing more
All Pydantic models use frozen=True for immutability
Configuration is validated strictly at construction time via Pydantic strict mode — invalid config raises at startup, not at runtime
No global state — all state flows through constructor parameters, method arguments, or injected dependencies
Structured JSON logging at all decision points using Python stdlib logging with a JSON formatter
Each source file stays under 300 lines: types.py ~120 lines, errors.py ~40 lines, client.py ~50 lines, remote.py ~80 lines, local.py ~80 lines
HealthReport never raises for operational failures — always returns a structured result with available=false on failure
RemoteModelAdapter maps: AuthError→TerminalError, InvalidRequestError→TerminalError, RateLimitError→RetriableError, RemoteUnavailableError→SourceUnavailableError
LocalModelAdapter maps: InferenceSuccess→CompletionResponse, LocalModelUnavailable→SourceUnavailableError
promote_model is only available on LocalModelAdapter — raises NotImplementedError on RemoteModelAdapter
requires: remote_api_client must expose RemoteClient protocol instances via create_remote_client factory
remote_api_client must return TaskResponse from send_request
remote_api_client must raise typed errors (AuthError, RateLimitError, RemoteUnavailableError, InvalidRequestError)
local_model_server must expose LocalModelClient protocol instances via async context manager
local_model_server must return InferenceResult (InferenceSuccess | LocalModelUnavailable) from infer
local_model_server must return HealthStatus from health
local_model_server must return PromotionResult from promote_model
